name: Bridger’s Crossing
history: Used by Varkesh and Rathen herders for generations; Amos established a ranch nearby after the war and preserved customary access.
current_state: Four-Spur concession encompasses crossing; surveyors placed boundary markers.
inhabitants: Amos Bridger (N-001), family, ranch hands, traveling herders; occasional Four-Spur riders.
danger_level: Low ordinarily; potentially moderate if dispute escalates.
points_of_interest: Ranchstead, livestock ford, Varkesh trail markers, campsite, boundary stakes.
discovery: Local ranchers and Varkesh herders; Amos may request assistance through the Redwash Exchange.
source_reference: Accepted campaign record example developed after Handbook v0.4
